question: How should AI edits and streaming reuse authored commands, selection and application policy?
trigger: Repeated reporter contradiction: ordinary AI output is green, the streaming indicator is missing, and generation changes Editing to Suggestion. Explicit Patch and Best API Review request.
requirements: AI generation and review preserve the user-selected input intent; only an explicit choice enables Suggestion.
Inline rich Markdown/MDX output has AI presentation and a visible streaming end; native focus and caret are verified separately for streaming, review and follow-up input.
Temporary AI output neither exposes unrelated proposals nor overwrites later explicit mode choices when the session finishes.
Apply uses canonical editor commands and native history/authored ownership; discard cannot undo unrelated edits or restore a whole-document snapshot.
evidenceReuse: Fresh source trace of both AI proposal publication paths, stream adapter, copied AI/Suggestion rendering, detached preview/application and Plite input routing. Reused the prior recovery text/history proof only within its original bounds. Chrome profile Ziad on localhost:3000/docs/components/ai-menu reproduced the new mode/color failure and missing dedicated stream indicator. Compared local main cce36d378b2f1e5c775dafe1a67c2215165c982c ai-node.tsx through git show; no main runtime replay.
summary: Pursue consolidating temporary AI output on one draft and applying it through normal commands. Cut the AI save/switch/restore mode protocol and proposal-versus-detached application split. The draft runtime and inline placement are provisional pending measured design and native proof. This reverses the recovery plan assumption that temporary AI review may enter propose/markup; it preserves the native authored engine for actual tracked suggestions and accepted writes.
alternatives: Keep/configure: restoring AI text marks or overriding green styles fixes only paint and leaves the input-policy defect.

Change existing API: edit/markup could decouple presentation from intent, but current Plite transactions choose coordinate space from intent, pending-text input requires a defined mapping law, and all pending changes would still appear. Removing validation alone is unsound.

Add a primitive: a filtered transient authored branch could isolate output, but adds projection/lifetime machinery and retains per-stream authored work; it needs an executable advantage over reuse of the existing draft.

Delete/merge/move ownership: consolidate previewValue, AIChatEditor and detached application under the existing AI feature lifecycle; delete AI mode snapshot/restore and dual proposal application. Reuse the canonical authored/history engine when the user applies the draft.

Replace architecture: a full-document fork, a private AI mutation engine or a public preview manager is not earned by this job. First test existing detached rich preview and node-wrapper placement; add neutral substrate only for a demonstrated gap.
proofLimits: This is a bounded AI preview-ownership review, not an exhaustive AI/Copilot audit. Native red observed Editing becoming Suggestion, green authored spans and no AILeaf streaming indicator. A native caret was visible in some phases; universal caret absence is not established. Existing content/history tests omit mode and streaming paint, and were not rerun as proof of those missing assertions. No product code changed, no target benchmark ran, no fixed-state proof is claimed. Repair remains open in the existing plan.
